name: Star Chef 2: Cooking Game
detailed_description:
👩‍🍳Hey Chefs! Are you ready to cook some delicious dishes at your restaurant? Dive into the joy of growing your own veggies on the farm, raising animals with care, and crafting exquisite dishes from scratch. Experience the seamless blend of cooking and farming as you create a variety of world-class cuisines to delight your customers. With your creativity and our state-of-the-art tools, build the restaurant of your dreams from the ground up. Let the flavors of your imagination come to life!>🏨

🥞Unleash the cooking fever by becoming a part of the chef community. Meet top chefs and visit their restaurants, join them, farm and cook & get the chance to win the title of <b>Master Chef</b> by participating in cooking competitions & tournaments.🍴

🧆Cook, bake and grill your finest meals catered to the needs of diners at your hotel. Compelling simulations like live music, celebrity appearances, pool parties, farms, and much more outside the restaurant kitchen are stirred up for your fun. This cooking mania will drive your entrepreneurial spirit to farm veggies, build restaurant, run hotel and manage your restaurant.👩‍💼

🍣 Enhance your cooking city, cook and farm your creative meals with our restaurant game. In this chef world, you get a chance to compete to secure the<b> Ultimate Title of Star Chef!</b> in your Restaurant🙏

<b>Why Install Star Chef 2 game?</b>

✔ Easy to use & stimulating interface

✔ Fun, addictive & action-packed cooking tycoon management

✔ Showcase your chef skills, farm veggies, and animals, and prepare a variety of cuisines in your restaurant

✔ Make your restaurant vibrant with distinctive decors & designs

<b>Game Features:</b>

<b>Intriguing Storylines</b>📖

150+ story-based quests and live the absolute chef life! Hone your management skills, farm and keep growing in the hotel kitchen of cooking madness!

<b>200+ Delicious Recipes</b>🍜

Ranging from pizzas & burgers to frittatas and even waffles! Bring out the chef in you and have loads of fun with our online hotel food game.

<b>Personalisation</b>🍽

Decorate your restaurant with unique design patterns ranging from wall decals & floor decors along with exceptional props! Revamp and renovate your restaurant with our lavish decorations.

<b>Hire International Chefs</b>👩‍🍳

Enhance your cooking diary with skilled international chefs. Grow your culinary skills & take part in cooking battles.

<b>Chef Teams</b>🏫

Chat and team up with your super chefs. Explore the well-knit community play features and team-up to collaborate & participate in tournaments.

<b>Trivia</b>🙋‍♀️

Grasp surprising and fun historical facts about cuisines and dishes as you keep growing as a restaurant tycoon.

<b>Farm and Harvest</b>👩‍🌾

Begin your cooking adventure by growing fresh farm produce in your backyard.

<b>Team Tournaments</b>🏆

Team Championship & Challenges to participate in and win!

<b>Play Mini Games</b>🎯

Enjoy Mini Games in the comfort of your Township

PLEASE NOTE!

Star Chef 2 is a cooking simulator game to download and play. Although some fascinating game items can be purchased for real money.

<b>Privacy Policy</b>:

Reach out to us at: support@99games.in

Start your culinary journey, farm & live the chef life. Download Star Chef 2 now to get cooking!

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630, AMD Radeon HD6570, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
